text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the installation of speed humps on Fifth Street, between Lake Shore Drive (south intersection) and Lake Shore Boulevard West. Staff's assessment indicates the criteria as set out in the updated Traffic Calming Policy has been satisfied. Therefore, speed humps should be installed on Fifth Street.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of speed humps on Fifth Street, between Lake Shore Drive (south intersection) and Lake Shore Boulevard West. 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter the roadway for the installation of six (6) speed humps on Fifth Street, between Lake Shore Drive (south intersection) and Lake Shore Boulevard West, generally as shown on Attachment 2 to the report (December 18, 2024) from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
